## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S3. This is audit backlog UX-23 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Walk-in success, board card menu, queue display · receptionist.
Findings and reviewers: F-15 · reviewer A-12.
Rationale: Tokens cannot be printed, reissued or cancelled; the desk speaks or writes the number by hand. After a reassignment, tokens B-01 and A-09 sat in the other doctor's queue and the display did not say whose they were.
Proposed UX behaviour: After check-in, Print slip opens a small print view: clinic name, token, doctor's name, date and time, and nothing else about the patient (no name, MRN, phone or reason). Reprint is on the card menu. A cancelled or left-without-being-seen visit's token is void and cannot be reprinted. After a reassignment the queue display shows the doctor beside each token.
Prototype and blueprint reference: None.
Components and tokens affected: A print view in the house print style; card menu. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end; small back end if the display needs the doctor per token.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the queue-rule ticket.
Clinical sign-off: Decision required before work starts: question 13 of the validation plan (paper token or spoken number). If spoken is enough, only the display part is built.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) A thermal printer integration. (2) Kiosk self check-in (MDV-P8-006).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a checked-in visit, when the slip is printed, then it shows clinic, token, doctor, date and time and no name, MRN, phone or reason, and the test fails if a name is added
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a waiting visit, when Reprint is chosen from the card menu, then the same token prints
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a cancelled visit, when Reprint is tried, then it is not offered and the server refuses
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a reassigned token, when the queue display renders, then the doctor's name is beside the token and no patient name appears
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the walk-in path, when it is measured without printing, then it is still at most 6 clicks new and 3 returning
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the slip view, when axe runs in English and Arabic, then there is no violation and it has one h1

## Test notes

- Playwright (tests/e2e/queue-tv.spec.ts, front-desk.spec.ts): slip content, reprint, reassigned token on the display.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
- Timing: not a pilot blocker; after the first pilot weeks unless the receptionist asks for paper at the validation session.
